name: Satou D. Ruby
source:
A vtuber who splits her time between themed livestreams and just chatting.
While her character concept is that she's a vampire of noble blood, she's extremely frugal with money and can't stomach horror games, so it's unclear if any of that is actually true.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2699600/]Steam[/url]]
